description: Governed solver stacks. Production defaults update only via explicit promotion; candidates stay quarantined.

quarantine.description: Candidate upgrades may be exercised by scheduled qualification without changing production defaults.

promotion_rules: Never edit production constraints from a candidate qualification job.
Candidate stacks live under packaging/quarantine/ or quarantine.candidates[].
Promotion requires a maintainer PR that updates packaging/constraints/ and this policy file together.
